title: "Enablers of Global Value Chains"
format: html

## Objectives
- Examine trade policy frameworks shaping Japan’s trade.  
- Assess domestic policies supporting competitiveness and innovation.  
- Discuss infrastructure as an enabler of GVC participation.  

## Key Concepts
- RCEP, CPTPP, WTO agreements.  
- Industrial policy and innovation systems.  
- Infrastructure logistics and connectivity.  

## Readings (Suggested)
- Kimura and Chen (2016), *Implications of Mega Free Trade Agreements for Asian Regional Integration and RCEP Negotiation*.  
- WTO and JETRO-IDE (2011), *Trade patterns and global value chains in East Asia: from trade in goods to trade in tasks*. 

## Discussion Questions
1. How does Japan balance multilateral and regional trade frameworks? 
2. Can domestic innovation policy substitute for trade openness?
